items.text: Update 3.0 is now available for Ayasa: Shadows of Silence on PC.

Thank you to everyone who played Ayasa and shared feedback. Earlier versions had technical issues that affected your experience, and we are sorry for the frustration. This update focuses on the problems you reported most often.
Performance: Improved frame rate for smoother gameplay.
Enemy AI: Improved enemy behavior.
Movement and controls: Refined character movement and responsiveness.
Sound and music: Improved the audio experience.
Bug fixes: Fixed numerous issues throughout the game.
If you have been waiting to return to Ayasa, this is a good time to try the updated game.
If you encounter a problem, please post the level, what happened, and your PC specifications in Steam Discussions. We will keep listening to your feedback.
Thank you to everyone who has played Ayasa: Shadows of Silence and shared feedback with us. We've been working hard on a new update focused on improving the overall experience.
✅ Enemy AI polished and improved
✅ New hints added to help guide players
✅ Character sound improvements
✅ Sound and audio polish across the game
✅ Performance optimizations
✅ General gameplay polish and bug fixes
Our goal is to make Ayasa smoother, more immersive, and more enjoyable for both new and returning players.
Thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait for you to experience the improved version of Ayasa: Shadows of Silence.
The update is coming soon. Stay tuned! 🖤
— Aya Games Team

notes.title: Thank You for Staying With Us

items.text: First of all, thank you to everyone who supported Ayasa: Shadows of Silence, gave fair reviews, and stayed with us while we continued improving the game.

We want to be honest — the original release did not come out in the state we truly wanted. In many ways, it felt closer to an Early Access version. We did not have enough time to fully finish several mechanics, parts of the boss fight, and overall polish.
With Version 2.0, we want to introduce a major update that brings the game much closer to the experience we originally planned.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/f6b3b8946e97a9e879377809d09a9fbe482db512.gif"]

Environmental improvements

Important bug fixes

Cutscenes now run more smoothly
This version is much closer to the experience we always wanted to deliver.
We hope you enjoy this new update. If you still find bugs, please let us know — we will continue fixing issues as quickly as possible with future patches.
Aya Games

Hey everyone,
We wanted to take a moment to give you a proper update on the upcoming patch and explain what’s been going on behind the scenes.

First of all, we’re sorry for the delay. During final testing, we ran into a number of unexpected issues that would have negatively affected stability and overall gameplay if we had pushed the update out as originally planned. Rather than release something we weren’t fully happy with, we made the decision to pause and address these problems properly.

Right now, the team is actively working on fixing these issues, polishing the remaining content, and making sure everything is running smoothly. Progress is going well, and we’re confident enough to share a new timeline.
The update is now planned to release next week.

We know delays can be frustrating, and we really appreciate your patience and understanding while we take the extra time needed to get this right. Your support and feedback mean a lot to us, and we want this update to meet the quality you expect.
We’ll continue to keep you informed as we get closer to release. Thanks again for sticking with us more news soon!

releases.displayName: Update Progress & Apology for the Delay

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248538/a84facb479834e7d199e1c8fa9f201274c0fb491.png"]December 1st was our last update, and we sincerely apologise for the lack of communication over the past twelve days. During this time, we have made the difficult decision to stop releasing updates and focus on more complex technical issues that cannot be fixed with quick solutions. We did not want to release smaller updates that would not truly improve the experience. Instead, we are working carefully to improve stability, smoothness, speed, reliability, enemy AI behaviour, and the boss fight, which should feel fair, intense and meaningful. More importantly, we aim to make the story flow clearly and experience it as it was intended. Our goal is to publish the next update prior to the Winter Sale. Thank you for your understanding, trust and belief in Ayasa: Shadows of Silence, your support means everything to us.
2. 17 Fully Localized Unlockable Achievements

Achievements are now available and fully localized in the following languages (all 17 included): English, German, French, Italian, Korean, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Finnish, Swedish, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian and Greek.
We finally fixed the broken saves. Saving should now work correctly.
*Note: If your game restarts after installing the update, don't worry. After the reboot, your new save files should work as expected.
General gameplay issues have been fixed. Movement, jumping and interaction should be smoother, instead of fighting every step of the way.
5. Controller Keymap Update
We reworked the keymap of the controller to improve playability. The updated mappings are now available in the settings menu.
Camera behavior adjustments, optimization passes, and multiple minor bug fixes.
Thank you all for your support of the game. We are working on more updates and improvements. If you encounter any new bugs or would like to join our community, please join our Discord.
